question: In which state is Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana launched ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana is an initiative launched by the Government of Jharkhand.
 
• This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers in the state to promote agricultural development and increase productivity.
 
• Under this scheme, farmers are provided with financial aid of up to INR 5,000 per acre for their Kharif crops.
 
• The primary objective of the scheme is to enhance the income of farmers and ensure their economic stability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishi Ashirwad Yojana:**

 
 
• It is a financial support scheme launched by the Jharkhand government to aid farmers in the state.
 
• The scheme focuses on providing monetary assistance to farmers for their Kharif crops, aiming to increase agricultural productivity and farmer income.
 
• The assistance provided under this scheme is expected to cover the cost of seeds, fertilizers, and other inputs required for farming.
 
• By supporting farmers financially, the government aims to improve the socio-economic conditions of the agricultural community in Jharkhand.
 
 
 
• **Kharif Crops:**
 
 
• Kharif crops are typically sown with the onset of the monsoon in June and harvested in October during the rainy season.
 
• Common Kharif crops include rice, maize, millet, and pulses.
 
• These crops require ample water supply for their growth, making the monsoon season ideal for their cultivation.
 
• The productivity of Kharif crops is highly dependent on the timing and amount of rainfall received during the monsoon.
 
 
 
• **Agricultural Development:**
 
 
• Agricultural development refers to the process of improving the efficiency and productivity of farming practices.
 
• It involves the adoption of modern techniques, improved seed varieties, and better irrigation methods to enhance crop yield.
 
• Government schemes like the Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana play a crucial role in promoting agricultural development by providing necessary financial support to farmers.
 
• Such initiatives aim to ensure food security, increase farmer income, and contribute to the overall economic growth of the region.
